prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high: both tests predicted positive gains (+14.0% and +6.0%), but both resulted in negative outcomes (-7.2% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Selection Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout with preview animation and choice cards to make picking intuitive. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long median time (89s), indicating users struggle to evaluate and pick a pet.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Progress and Tip Carousel: Display animated tips and estimated load progress while the pet is being generated and loaded onto the desktop. (why: The home waiting step has long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s) and support reports pets failing to show up on desktop.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Path Selection Cards with Custom vs Instant Flow Preview: Introduce visual choice cards in a two-column layout comparing instant pet adoption versus custom photo creation. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and takes 514s on average, indicating decision paralysis between options.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Auto-Sync and Persistence Helper: Add explanatory copy and sync notice clarifying that signing in preserves pet profiles safely across sessions. (why: Top support complaint is pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails).)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Welcome Spotlight with Direct Desktop Test: Redesign home_intro into a spotlight layout with an active pet mascot component encouraging direct desktop interaction. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with mean time over 5800s, showing users get stuck before concluding onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Warm Desktop Pet Story Intro Copy Refresh: Rewrite story screen copy to focus on screen companionship and daily delight. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at the initial screen before picking a pet path.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Ready Status Banner and Loading Indicator: Show an active connection progress bar and recovery hint on the sign-in screen. (why: Support reported users experiencing sign-in screen stalling or failing to load (2 emails).)

scores.note: Adoption redesign previously resulted in -7.2% lift; high cost screen redesign.
Both funnel wait times and support emails confirm desktop loading issues.
Addresses drop at choose_path step, but requires new layout components.
Top support complaint (8 emails) and sign_in funnel drop; quick copy/config fix.
Large loss at finish step, but full spotlight redesign requires a new release.
Low cost text update for entry step, backed by drop-off funnel data.
Backed by sign-in funnel drop and 2 support tickets regarding stalling.
